ORDER Present miscellaneous appeal has been filed against the award dated 03.2.2006 passed by Third Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Morena, District Morena in Claim Case No. 194/2004.

sentences.text: The facts in brief to decide this appeal in brief are that the appellant - claimant filed a claim petition under Section 163-A of Motor Vehicles Act for grant of compensation on account of permanent disability caused to him in a motor accident occurred on 18.10.2003 involving a mini bus bearing registration No. MP06 B 1204.

sentences.text: As per the averments in claim petition, at the time of accident, present appellant-claimant was driving the aforesaid mini bus slowly on his left hand side.
When the bus reached near Bamba towards Ambah, the bus turned turtle on account of which present appellant - claimant received grievous injuries.
Due to injuries sustained by the claimant, he became permanently disabled on account of which compensation to the tune of Rs.17,40,000/- was sought in different heads by filing the claim petition.

Respondents No. 1 - owner of the aforesaid bus filed his written statement and opposed the averments made in the claim petition stating that since appellant-claimant was employed under respondent No. 1 at the time of accident and he was on duty, therefore, appellant ought to have filed the claim petition under the Workman Compensation Act before the Labour Court.

It was further stated that since the bus was insured with respondent No. 2-insurance company, therefore,
insurance company is liable to pay the compensation.
However, respondent No. 1 - owner remained absent before the learned claims tribunal and was proceeded ex-parte.

Respondent No. 2 submitted its reply stating that the offending vehicle was being driven in violation of the terms and conditions of the insurance policy as appellant-claimant did not have any valid driving license and the accident occurred due to appellant's own mistake, therefore, respondent No.
2-insurance company is not liable to pay the compensation and prayed to dismiss the claim petition.

Learned claims tribunal framed issues and after taking evidence of both the parties partly allowed the claim petition and compensation to the tune of Rs.2,45,000/- was awarded which was directed to be paid by respondents No. 1 and 2 - owner and insurance company of the aforesaid mini bus.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that learned claims tribunal has wrongly assessed the monthly income of the claimant as Rs.2000/-, however, it should have been Rs.3000/- per month on the basis of evidence produced by the claimant.
It is further argued that the amount awarded under the head of "Pain and Suffering" as well as "Medical Treatment" is also on the lesser side.

Further argument is that learned claims tribunal has erred in not considering that on account of accident, claimant suffered permanent disability of left hand and he is not able to work as a driver,
therefore, just and proper compensation be awarded to the appellant - claimant.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the insurance company supported the impugned award and prayed for rejection of this appeal.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the available record.

Having gone through the evidence adduced by the both the parties before learned claims tribunal and considering the nature of the case, the compensation as awarded by learned claims tribunal is liable to be enhanced by Rs.2,00,000/- (Rs. One Lakh only) in lump sum which shall be payable to appellant - claimant in addition to already awarded amount by the claims tribunal i.e. Rs.2,45,000/-.

sentences.text: The enhanced amount of Rs.2,00,000/- shall not carry any interest, however, if the respondents fail to make the payment of compensation within a period of 12 months from today, then the enhanced amount of award shall carry penal interest at the rate of 6% per annum.
Rest of the conditions as imposed by learned claims tribunal shall remain intact.

If the enhanced amount of compensation is in excess to the valuation of appeal, the difference of the Court fee (if not already paid) shall be deposited by the appellant - claimant within four weeks' from today and proof thereof shall be submitted before the Registry.
Thereafter, Registry shall issue the certified copy of the order passed today.
Appeal stand allowed to the aforesaid extent and disposed of.
